fieldNotes.location: Roster address (4500 Murray Pl) is wrong. Real plant confirmed at 230 Jefferson Ridge Pkwy, Lynchburg VA 24501 via Waze/Yelp/PotatoPro. Locked center 37.40036,-79.238328.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck driveway connects to Jefferson Ridge Pkwy as a wide open paved apron at z19/z20 imagery with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint. Open ingress.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the entrance or inside the yard. A cluster mid-yard read as parked tractors, not a structure. Listed uncertain because Street View coverage on the private parkway is partial.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long approach from parkway into the trailer yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and large open yard mouth; ample paved width to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large drop-trailer fields (north fan-out lot ~50+ stalls; east linear rows 40+) — well over 50 trailers visible.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks span multiple building faces (long east bank plus south/southeast bank) — distinct clusters consistent with separate ship/receive.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: A separate smaller building sits at the north end of the property near the drop yard; counted as buildingCount 2 but it is a single Frito-Lay campus, not separate facilities.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town hilltop industrial park in Lynchburg surrounded by woods; Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Counts are honest overhead estimates; dock doors ~70 across long east bank and south bank, trailers ~110 in drop rows and at docks.
